sections.0.items.1.text: One of Taiwan's first dive shops
sections.0.items.2.spans.0.t:
綠芙The Reef 是由一位叫做KEN的元老級潛水教練所創立 
The Reef was founded by KEN, a veteran dive instructor.
sections.0.items.2.spans.1.t: 他是一個60+老屁孩，關於大海的故事，絕對是你能遇過最豐富最多的人，畢竟有點年紀了，還想趁潛不動以前，再去一次世界各地探望以前那些厲害的潛點，所以他不一定會在島上（想他要預約）但一定在某個地方吐泡泡。

He's a 60-something big kid with more ocean stories than anyone you'll ever meet. While he still can, he wants to revisit the great dive sites around the world, so he isn't always on the island (book ahead if you want to dive with him), but he's surely blowing bubbles somewhere.
sections.0.items.3.text:
從小在關島長大
在菲律賓及澳洲長期教學

中英台語多聲道
30年以上的潛水教學資歷
水下兇巴巴只是怕你會危險
水上不正經基本是他的常態
想去世界各地的潛點問他沒錯
他是活字典。

Grew up in Guam
Taught for years in the Philippines and Australia

Speaks Chinese, English and Taiwanese
30+ years of teaching diving
Strict underwater, only because he wants you safe
Never serious above water, that's just him
Want to dive anywhere in the world? Ask him.
He's a walking encyclopedia.
sections.1.items.3.text: 豪華雙人房、四人房和背包客房，就在潛水中心旁。
Deluxe double, quad and backpacker rooms, right next to the dive center.
sections.1.items.4.text: PADI 體驗潛水、OW、AOW 到進修課程，岸潛和船潛都有。
PADI Discover Scuba, Open Water, Advanced and continuing education, shore and boat dives.
sections.1.items.5.text: 3 天 2 夜套裝含船票和機車，也能加購浮潛、潮間帶和夜釣。
3-day, 2-night packages with ferry and scooter; add snorkeling, tide pools or night fishing.
